title: 🚀 New Collisions Tab in Properties Overview for TileMaker DOT
author: ObjectiveCrysis22
selftext:
Hey, just rolled out a fresh update for the TileMaker DOT to make inspecting your objects faster and cleaner!

Here is what's new in this build:

Collisions Tab in Properties Overview: Added a separate Collisions tab right alongside Instance and Template properties so you can view object collision details cleanly without clutter

Bug Fixes & Small Polishes: Squashed minor bugs and wrapped up general quality-of-life improvements under the hood

🕹️ Itch.io: https://crytek22.itch.io/tilemakerdot

💻 GitHub: https://github.com/andrei-voia/TileMakerDOT

📺 YouTube Tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3fiajGU32Jg

For anyone unfamiliar with the project, TileMaker DOT is a free (with a very complete, professional cheap version too), open-source 2D map editor I'm building. It uses a data-first, ID-based workflow and handles visual depth sorting automatically so you don't have to juggle complex layer setups for object heights. 🗺️🌲

Give it a try and let me know if you have any feedback! If the editor helps with your projects and you want to support development, a rating or a small donation on Itch is always hugely appreciated. 💖

Thank you all so much for your continued support!

comments.author: HugoDzz
comments.body: Very cool, nice to see some other tilemap editor, I made my [own](https://www.spritefusion.com/) back in 2023 and kept improving it since then!
